user.title: Connect to Tekmar Gateway
user.description: Enter the credentials for a Watts Home / tekmar account that has access to your Gateway 486. For safety, create a dedicated user via the gateway web UI (Users → Invite) rather than reusing your primary login.

building.title: Select building
building.description: Your account has access to more than one building. Pick the one to manage in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Tekmar Gateway
reauth_confirm.description: Tekmar rejected the stored credentials for {username}. Re-enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the tekmar gateway service. Try again in a minute.
error.no_buildings: Sign-in worked, but the account has no buildings.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log.
